narration.full_text: Welcome to our General Science flashcards! This section is designed to help you quickly review key concepts and test your understanding. We'll go through important terms and definitions, so you can reinforce your learning. Get ready to recall what you've learned and strengthen your knowledge base. Let's dive in!
